headline: Tabled flashing yield signs for the Derry Rotary, speed statistics, and a sight distance request at 145 Warner Hill Road; approved August minutes.
summary: Members discussed adding flashing yield signs at the five rotary entrances, with a cost of $975.00 at the price checked. They tabled the sign decision, the speed statistics request, and the sight distance request for 145 Warner Hill Road until the next meeting.
decisions: Approved the August 20, 2026 meeting minutes, 5-0, with two abstentions.
Tabled the flashing yield sign purchase for the rotary until the next meeting.
Tabled the speed statistics for traffic studies until the next meeting.
Tabled the request for a sight distance safety assessment at 145 Warner Hill Road until the next meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Ron Goldthwaite made a motion to approve the August 20, 2026, minutes as written. Seconded by Jodi Nelson. ... MOTION PASSED (5-0), with Scott Savard and Lt. Breen abstaining.
Tabled to the next meeting, when Clint Havens will have more accurate flashing yield sign costs.
Tabled to the next meeting, Clint Havens to provide speed statistics before then.
Mr. Kendall Venable – 145 Warner Hill Road – request for a sight distance safety assessment, installation of a hidden driveway warning sign, etc. ... Tabled to the next meeting.

decision_titles: Flashing yield signs at the five rotary entrances
Sight distance assessment at 145 Warner Hill Road
